levels.name: First Ramp
levels.objective: Make the ball roll down the ramp and hit the target
levels.description: Learn the basics: position the ramp correctly to guide the ball to the target

levels.name: Double Ramp
levels.objective: Use two ramps to create a path to the target
levels.description: Connect two ramps to guide the ball on a longer course

levels.name: Ramp and Dominoes
levels.objective: Combine ramp and dominoes to activate the target
levels.description: Use a ramp to give speed to the ball and knock down the dominoes

levels.name: Cannon & Candle
levels.objective: Reach the target with the cannon ball
levels.description: Position the candle to fire up the cannon

levels.name: Simple Seesaw
levels.objective: Use a lever to launch the ball at the target
levels.description: Position a weight to make the seesaw catapult the ball

levels.name: Swing
levels.objective: Arrange the swing to reach the target
levels.description: Position the swing to create the chain reaction

levels.name: Double Ramp with Jump
levels.objective: Create a jump between two ramps to reach the target
levels.description: Position the ramps with the correct spacing for the ball to jump between them

levels.name: Double Seesaw
levels.objective: Use two seesaws in sequence to reach the elevated target
levels.description: Coordinate two lever systems to reach the high platform

levels.name: Domino Maze
levels.objective: Create a complex path with 7 dominoes
levels.description: Dominoes must form a zigzag pattern to the target

levels.name: Complex Machine
levels.description: Complete Rube Goldberg system with multiple stages

levels.name: Lever Cascade
levels.objective: Three levers in sequence to reach the top
levels.description: Chained catapult system launching balls progressively higher

levels.name: Final Masterpiece
levels.objective: Complete the ultimate Rube Goldberg machine!
levels.description: All elements: ramps, dominoes, levers and jumps. The culmination of everything you've learned!
